guarantee: A completed listener enrollment revocation/expiry or configured-source change during provider I/O prevents every later Core mutation or applied receipt. Recheck existing authority after readback, after evidence collection and immediately before effect calls; release the delivery for a valid future owner. These are fresh consumption checks, not atomic exclusion against changes occurring after a check.

cases.RA01: Gate real loopback readback, revoke signed enrollment while Core capability remains valid, then release: task and applied receipt remain unchanged; listener stops and delivery is recoverable.
cases.RA02: The same ordering with enrollment expiry, receiver config, secret and credential changes refuses ordinary, reordered and outbound-echo application branches.
cases.RA03: Loss during evidence collection prevents settlement; loss after a prior legitimate Core application prevents a new applied receipt and retains the committed fact for recovery.
cases.RA04: Removal/scope-removal and recovered-application branches consume current authority; revoked source cannot be replaced by a still-valid Core capability.
cases.RA05: Positive authenticated wake/drain, durable restart, duplicate handling and installed command cleanup retain their existing controls. No runtime endpoint override or new authority issuer.

limits: Authored provider/local installed checks only. Original failed independent review remains retained; no live Linear/model/ngrok/credential effects.
